placements.why: The envelope's content is an E2E test description whose organizational home is verification/validation work, not opportunity, strategy, product, architecture, org, or template concerns. No strata exists yet in this repo, and nothing supplied is even close to this organizational category, so it is minted standalone as the strata tier's first real entry, grounded directly in this envelope's testing content.
placements.title: Testing and validation work substantiates system claims through reproducible artifacts
placements.frame: What production behavior or failure does this test artifact reproduce, and what guarantee does it exist to verify?

placements.title: Malformed input must derive a valid output rather than crash the pipeline
placements.frame: What malformed or id-less input pattern from production is being reproduced, and does the derivation degrade into a valid output instead of failing?
placements.why: src-1 names the specific prod failure pattern (a heading without an id field) that the test reproduces, and src-2 states the behavioral contract the reproduction must satisfy (no crash, valid slug produced) — together a single recurring theme about robustness of id/slug derivation under malformed input, a subject future test envelopes in this pipeline will keep feeding rather than a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaf covers this (structure is empty), so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Proof strata, since this is exactly the kind of validation-artifact theme that category exists to hold.
